content.title: About
content.content: Breakfast bar, NFS is a ready‑to‑eat breakfast bar containing whole grains, nuts, dried fruit and added vitamins. It is designed for a quick on‑the‑go snack, providing energy and nutrients during the first hours of the day.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: NFS bars are made from whole oat flakes, preserving most of the dietary fiber.
They contain extracts of acai and blueberry berries, rich in antioxidants.
Each bar provides about 15 g of plant‑based protein from pea protein isolate.
The product is gluten‑free, suitable for people with celiac disease.
Packaging is made from recyclable material in line with sustainability principles.

items.title: Energy support
items.content: The mix of complex carbs and protein delivers a steady energy release without sharp blood‑sugar spikes.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole grains and dried fruit supply dietary fiber that promotes healthy digestion.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Added B1, B2, B6 and B12 vitamins support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Berry extracts help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Low sugar content
items.content: Sugar is replaced with natural sweeteners, making the bar suitable for moderate consumption.

items.title: Nut allergy
items.content: Contains almonds and cashews, which may trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Calorie density
items.content: One bar contains roughly 200 kcal, so it should fit within your daily energy budget.

items.title: Caffeine content
items.content: Some variants include guarana extract, which adds a small amount of caffeine.

items.title: Sugar level
items.content: Although reduced, people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The bar is ready to eat straight from the pack. It is convenient to carry in a bag, at work or the gym. For extra bulk you can crumble it into yogurt, smoothies or oatmeal.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal the package tightly to maintain crunchiness. For long‑term storage (over 6 months) keep refrigerated.
